title: Log time on a task
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and select the week you want.
2. Select **Add row** and choose the project and task.
3. Enter the hours in the box under the correct day.
4. Select **Save**.
Your hours appear in the weekly total straight away.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Start a timer on a task
body:
1. Open the task from **Projects**.
2. Select the **Start timer** button beside the task name.
3. Work as normal. The timer keeps running if you change pages.
4. Select **Stop timer** when you finish.
5. Check the entry in **Timesheets** and select **Save** to keep it.

title: Edit a time entry
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and open the week containing the entry.
2. Select the entry you want to change.
3. Update the hours, task or date.
4. Select **Save changes**.
You can only edit entries on timesheets that are still in **Draft** or **Rejected** status.
You can reverse this at any time by repeating the steps.

title: Delete a time entry
aliases: get rid of a timesheet entry
remove hours I booked by mistake
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and open the week containing the entry.
2. Select the entry you want to remove.
3. Select **Delete entry**.
4. Confirm by selecting **Delete**.
Deleted entries cannot be restored, so log the time again if you removed it by mistake.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Submit a timesheet for approval
aliases: send my timesheet to my manager
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and open the week you want to submit.
2. Check that each day shows the hours you expect.
3. Select **Submit for approval**.
4. Confirm in the dialog.
The status changes to **Submitted** and your approver is notified.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Approve a timesheet
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and select the **To approve** tab.
2. Select the member whose timesheet you want to review.
3. Check the entries and any notes.
4. Select **Approve**.
The member is notified and the hours become available for reports and invoices.
The change is recorded in the activity log for your workspace.

title: Reject a timesheet and ask for changes
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and select the **To approve** tab.
2. Open the submitted timesheet.
3. Select **Reject**.
4. Type a short reason in the **Comment** box.
5. Select **Send back**.
The status changes to **Rejected** so the member can edit and resubmit.
You can reverse this at any time by repeating the steps.

title: Mark a time entry as billable
aliases: charge the client for an entry
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and open the week containing the entry.
2. Select the entry.
3. Switch on the **Billable** toggle.
4. Select **Save changes**.
Billable hours use the billing rate set for that member or project, and appear when you generate an invoice.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Add a note to a time entry
aliases: write a comment on my hours
attach a description to logged time
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and open the week you want.
2. Select the entry you want to describe.
3. Type your text in the **Note** box. Keep it short and specific.
4. Select **Save changes**.
Notes show on approver screens and on invoices if you choose to include them.

title: Set a member's weekly hours target
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Members**.
2. Select the member's name.
3. In the **Working hours** section, enter the number of hours per week.
4. Select **Save**.
Timesheets show the target so members can see how close they are to it.
The change is recorded in the activity log for your workspace.

title: Export timesheets to CSV
aliases: save timesheet data as a CSV file
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and select the **All timesheets** tab.
2. Choose a date range using the **Period** filter.
3. Filter by member or project if needed.
4. Select **Export** and choose **CSV**.
The file downloads to your device and includes one row per time entry.

title: Lock a timesheet period
aliases: close the month for time entry
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Time tracking**.
2. Under **Locked periods**, select **Add lock**.
3. Choose the date up to which timesheets should be locked.
4. Select **Lock period**.
Members can no longer add or edit time before that date. Only workspace admins can remove a lock.

title: Log time for another member
aliases: book hours for a team member
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and select **Switch member**.
2. Choose the person from the list.
3. Add a row and enter their hours as you would your own.
4. Select **Save**.
Only project managers and admins can log time for others. The entry shows who created it.

title: Reopen a submitted timesheet
aliases: pull back a timesheet I already sent
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and open the submitted week.
2. Select **Recall**.
3. Confirm by selecting **Return to draft**.
4. Make your changes.
5. Select **Submit for approval** again.
You cannot recall a timesheet once it has been approved. Ask an approver to reject it instead.

title: Copy last week's rows into this week
aliases: reuse my rows from last week
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and open the current week.
2. Select the **More** menu in the top right.
3. Select **Copy last week**.
4. Choose whether to copy rows only or rows with hours.
5. Select **Copy**.
You can then adjust the hours for each day before you submit.

title: Add an activity type
aliases: add a category such as Design or Meetings
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Time tracking**.
2. Select **Activity types**.
3. Select **New activity type**.
4. Enter a name and choose whether it is billable by default.
5. Select **Save**.
Members can pick the new type when they log time.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Turn on time rounding
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Time tracking**.
2. Switch on **Round time entries**.
3. Choose an increment such as 6, 15 or 30 minutes.
4. Choose **Round up** or **Round to nearest**.
5. Select **Save**.
Rounding applies to new entries only. Existing entries stay as they are.

title: Set a project budget
aliases: add a budget to a project
give a project a spending limit
body:
1. Open the project from **Projects**.
2. Select the **Budget** tab.
3. Select **Set budget**.
4. Choose **Hours** or **Amount**, then enter the value.
5. Select **Save**.
Spend is tracked against the budget as members log billable time and add expenses.
The change is recorded in the activity log for your workspace.

title: Edit a project budget
body:
1. Open the project from **Projects**.
2. Select the **Budget** tab.
3. Select **Edit budget**.
4. Enter the new value and a reason in the **Note** box.
5. Select **Save**.
Each change is kept in the **Budget history** so approvers can see who changed it and when.

title: Set a budget alert threshold
aliases: warn me when a project is nearly over budget
get notified at 80 percent of budget
body:
1. Open the project and select the **Budget** tab.
2. Select **Alerts**.
3. Enter the percentage of the budget that should trigger a warning, for example 80.
4. Choose who should be notified.
5. Select **Save**.
Alerts are sent once when the threshold is passed.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Add a billing rate
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Billing rates**.
2. Select **New rate**.
3. Enter a name, such as Senior consultant, and the hourly amount.
4. Choose the currency.
5. Select **Save**.
You can then assign the rate to members or projects.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Update a member's billing rate
aliases: give a person a new charge-out rate
switch a member to a different rate
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Members**.
2. Select the member's name.
3. In the **Billing rate** section, choose a rate or enter a custom amount.
4. Select an **Effective from** date.
5. Select **Save**.
Time logged before the effective date keeps the old rate.
The change is recorded in the activity log for your workspace.

title: Delete a billing rate
aliases: remove a rate from the rate card
get rid of an old hourly rate
how do I delete a billing rate
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Billing rates**.
2. Find the rate you no longer need.
3. Select the **More** menu beside it, then **Delete**.
4. If members use the rate, choose a replacement rate.
5. Confirm by selecting **Delete rate**.
Existing invoices are not affected.

title: Set a client-specific rate
aliases: charge one client a different rate
body:
1. Go to **Clients** and select the client.
2. Select the **Rates** tab.
3. Select **Add override**.
4. Choose the rate to replace and enter the client's amount.
5. Select **Save**.
Overrides apply to all that client's projects unless a project has its own rate.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Add an expense to a project
body:
1. Open the project from **Projects**.
2. Select the **Budget** tab, then **Expenses**.
3. Select **Add expense**.
4. Enter the date, amount, category and a description.
5. Select **Save**.
Expenses count towards the project budget.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Delete an expense
aliases: take off an expense I added twice
how do I delete an expense
body:
1. Open the project from **Projects**.
2. Select the **Budget** tab, then **Expenses**.
3. Select the expense you want to remove.
4. Select **Delete expense**.
5. Confirm by selecting **Delete**.
The budget total updates immediately. Expenses already invoiced cannot be deleted.
The change is recorded in the activity log for your workspace.

title: Mark an expense as billable
aliases: pass a cost on to the client
charge an expense to the customer
body:
1. Open the project and select **Budget**, then **Expenses**.
2. Select the expense.
3. Switch on **Billable**.
4. Optionally enter a markup percentage.
5. Select **Save changes**.
Billable expenses are added to the next invoice you generate.
You can reverse this at any time by repeating the steps.

title: Export a project budget to CSV
aliases: get budget data in a spreadsheet
body:
1. Open the project from **Projects**.
2. Select the **Budget** tab.
3. Select **Export** in the top right.
4. Choose **CSV**.
The file includes budget, spend, remaining amount and a row for each expense.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Change a budget from hours to amount
body:
1. Open the project and select the **Budget** tab.
2. Select **Edit budget**.
3. Change **Budget type** to **Amount**.
4. Enter the new total. Harbour does not convert hours automatically.
5. Select **Save**.
Spend is recalculated using each member's billing rate.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Update a client's billing contact email
body:
1. Go to **Clients** and select the client.
2. Select the **Billing** tab.
3. Select **Edit** beside **Billing contact**.
4. Enter the new name and email address.
5. Select **Save**.
Future invoices are sent to the new address. Invoices already sent are not resent.
The change is recorded in the activity log for your workspace.

title: Update a client's phone number
body:
1. Go to **Clients** and select the client.
2. Select the **Details** tab.
3. Select **Edit** beside **Phone**.
4. Enter the new number, including the area code.
5. Select **Save**.
The number also appears on the client's invoices if contact details are switched on.
You can reverse this at any time by repeating the steps.

title: Generate an invoice from tracked time
body:
1. Go to **Billing** and select **New invoice**.
2. Choose the client and project.
3. Select the date range to include.
4. Review the approved billable time and expenses, and untick anything to leave out.
5. Select **Create draft**.
Check the draft, then select **Send** to email it to the billing contact.

title: Send an invoice payment reminder
body:
1. Go to **Billing** and select the **Unpaid** tab.
2. Open the overdue invoice.
3. Select **Send reminder**.
4. Edit the message if you like.
5. Select **Send**.
The reminder goes to the client's billing contact and is logged on the invoice.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Mark an invoice as paid
body:
1. Go to **Billing** and open the invoice.
2. Select **Record payment**.
3. Enter the payment date and amount.
4. Select **Save**.
If the full amount is recorded, the status changes to **Paid** and the invoice no longer appears under **Unpaid**.
The change is recorded in the activity log for your workspace.

title: Create a template from an existing project
aliases: save a project as a template
turn a project into a template
body:
1. Open the project from **Projects**.
2. Select the **More** menu, then **Save as template**.
3. Enter a name and description.
4. Choose whether to keep members and budget settings.
5. Select **Create template**.
Logged time and comments are never copied into a template.
You can reverse this at any time by repeating the steps.

title: Start a new project from a template
aliases: spin up a project from a template
body:
1. Go to **Templates**.
2. Find the template you want and select **Use template**.
3. Enter the project name and choose a client.
4. Set the start date. Task due dates shift to match.
5. Select **Create project**.
The new project opens with all template tasks, milestones and roles in place.

title: Rename a template
aliases: how do I rename a template
body:
1. Go to **Templates** and open the template.
2. Select **Edit details**.
3. Type the new name in the **Name** field.
4. Select **Save**.
Projects already created from the template keep their own names.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Edit a template's description
aliases: update what a template is for
how do I edit a template's description
body:
1. Go to **Templates** and open the template.
2. Select **Edit details**.
3. Update the text in the **Description** box.
4. Select **Save**.
A clear description helps other members choose the right template.
The change is recorded in the activity log for your workspace.
You can reverse this at any time by repeating the steps.

title: Duplicate a template
aliases: make a variation of a template
body:
1. Go to **Templates**.
2. Select the **More** menu beside the template.
3. Select **Duplicate**.
4. Enter a name for the copy.
5. Select **Create copy**.
The copy starts in **Draft** status, so you can edit it before sharing.
You can reverse this at any time by repeating the steps.

title: Delete a template
aliases: get rid of a template I don't need
how do I delete a template
body:
1. Go to **Templates**.
2. Select the **More** menu beside the template.
3. Select **Delete**.
4. Confirm by selecting **Delete template**.
Projects already created from it are not affected. If you might need the template later, archive it instead.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Archive a template
body:
1. Go to **Templates**.
2. Select the **More** menu beside the template.
3. Select **Archive**.
Archived templates no longer appear when people start a new project. Select the **Archived** filter to see them, and restore them whenever you need.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Restore an archived template
aliases: how do I restore an archived template
body:
1. Go to **Templates**.
2. Select the **Archived** filter.
3. Select the **More** menu beside the template.
4. Select **Restore**.
The template returns to the main list with its previous status.
The change is recorded in the activity log for your workspace.
You can reverse this at any time by repeating the steps.

title: Add a task to a template
aliases: put a new task in a template
add a step to a template
how do I add a task to a template
body:
1. Go to **Templates** and open the template.
2. Select the **Tasks** tab.
3. Select **Add task**.
4. Enter a task name and set the **Due after** value, such as 5 days after the project starts.
5. Select **Save**.
Tasks can be reordered by dragging them in the list.

title: Edit a task in a template
aliases: update task details in a template
how do I edit a task in a template
body:
1. Go to **Templates** and open the template.
2. Select the **Tasks** tab.
3. Select the task you want to change.
4. Update the name, description or **Due after** value.
5. Select **Save**.
Changes only affect projects created from the template in future.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Remove a task from a template
aliases: take a step out of a template
how do I remove a task from a template
body:
1. Go to **Templates** and open the template.
2. Select the **Tasks** tab.
3. Select the **More** menu beside the task.
4. Select **Remove task**.
5. Confirm in the dialog.
Subtasks of the task are removed too.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Add a milestone to a template
aliases: put a milestone in a template
set key dates in a template
how do I add a milestone to a template
body:
1. Go to **Templates** and open the template.
2. Select the **Milestones** tab.
3. Select **Add milestone**.
4. Enter a name and the number of days after the project start.
5. Select **Save**.
Milestones appear on the project timeline when the template is used.
The change is recorded in the activity log for your workspace.

title: Set default roles in a template
aliases: how do I set default roles in a template
body:
1. Go to **Templates** and open the template.
2. Select the **Roles** tab.
3. Select **Add role** and enter a name such as Designer.
4. Choose a billing rate for the role.
5. Select **Save**.
When someone starts a project, they assign a real member to each role.

title: Share a template with the whole workspace
aliases: make a template available to everyone
body:
1. Go to **Templates** and open your private template.
2. Select **Share**.
3. Choose **Everyone in workspace**.
4. Select **Publish**.
Other members can use it but only you and admins can edit it. Change the status back to **Private** at any time.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Import template tasks from a CSV file
aliases: bulk add tasks from a spreadsheet
how do I import template tasks from a csv file
body:
1. Go to **Templates** and open the template.
2. Select the **Tasks** tab.
3. Select **Import**, then **Choose CSV file**.
4. Match the columns in your file to **Name**, **Description** and **Due after**.
5. Select **Import tasks**.
Rows with errors are skipped and listed so you can fix them.

title: Turn on email notifications
body:
1. Select your profile picture and choose **Notification settings**.
2. Open the **Email** tab.
3. Switch on **Email notifications**.
4. Tick the events you want, such as task assignments and approvals.
5. Select **Save**.
Emails are sent to the address on your profile.
The change is recorded in the activity log for your workspace.

title: Turn off task assignment emails
aliases: stop emails when I'm assigned a task
how do I turn off task assignment emails
body:
1. Select your profile picture and choose **Notification settings**.
2. Open the **Email** tab.
3. Untick **Task assigned to me**.
4. Select **Save**.
You will still see assignments in the notification bell inside Harbour.
You can reverse this at any time by repeating the steps.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Change the email address for notifications
aliases: send alerts to a different email
body:
1. Select your profile picture and choose **Profile**.
2. Select **Edit** beside **Email**.
3. Enter your new email address.
4. Select **Save** and confirm using the code we email you.
All notifications will go to the new address once it is verified.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Switch to a daily digest email
aliases: get one summary email a day
body:
1. Select your profile picture and choose **Notification settings**.
2. Open the **Email** tab.
3. Under **Delivery**, choose **Daily digest**.
4. Pick the time you want it sent.
5. Select **Save**.
Urgent items such as rejected timesheets are still sent straight away.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Mute a project's notifications
body:
1. Open the project from **Projects**.
2. Select the bell icon at the top of the page.
3. Select **Mute project**.
4. Choose how long to mute it, or select **Until I turn it on**.
Direct mentions still reach you. Select **Unmute** from the same menu to resume everything else.

title: Unmute a project
aliases: turn alerts back on for a project
how do I unmute a project
body:
1. Open the project from **Projects**.
2. Select the bell icon at the top of the page.
3. Select **Unmute project**.
You will receive notifications for the project again, based on your usual settings.
You can reverse this at any time by repeating the steps.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Set quiet hours
body:
1. Select your profile picture and choose **Notification settings**.
2. Open the **Schedule** tab.
3. Switch on **Quiet hours**.
4. Choose a start and end time and the days it applies to.
5. Select **Save**.
Notifications are held and delivered when quiet hours end.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Turn on mobile push notifications
aliases: how do I turn on mobile push notifications
body:
1. Open the Harbour Projects app on your phone.
2. Select **More**, then **Notification settings**.
3. Switch on **Push notifications**.
4. Allow notifications when your phone asks.
5. Choose the events you want.
Push settings are separate for each device.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Add a mobile number for text alerts
aliases: update my phone number for SMS
get text messages for urgent alerts
change my mobile number for alerts
body:
1. Select your profile picture and choose **Notification settings**.
2. Open the **Text message** tab.
3. Select **Edit number** and enter your mobile number.
4. Enter the code we text you.
5. Select **Verify**.
Text alerts are only sent for overdue deadlines and rejected timesheets.
The change is recorded in the activity log for your workspace.

title: Choose how you are notified of mentions
aliases: how do I choose how you are notified of mentions
body:
1. Select your profile picture and choose **Notification settings**.
2. Find **Mentions**.
3. Choose **Email**, **Push**, or both.
4. Select **Save**.
Mentions are always shown in the notification bell, whichever delivery options you pick.
You can reverse this at any time by repeating the steps.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Set reminders for overdue tasks
aliases: remind me when tasks are late
how do I set reminders for overdue tasks
body:
1. Select your profile picture and choose **Notification settings**.
2. Open the **Reminders** tab.
3. Switch on **Overdue tasks**.
4. Choose how often to be reminded: daily or weekly.
5. Select **Save**.
Reminders list only tasks assigned to you.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Turn off timer reminders
aliases: how do I turn off timer reminders
body:
1. Select your profile picture and choose **Notification settings**.
2. Open the **Reminders** tab.
3. Switch off **Timer still running**.
4. Select **Save**.
You can switch it back on at any time. Workspace admins may also set a default for new members.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Mark all notifications as read
body:
1. Select the bell icon at the top of any page.
2. Select **Mark all as read**.
Notifications stay in the list for 30 days, so you can open them later. Select **Unread** to show only the ones you have not seen yet.
The change is recorded in the activity log for your workspace.

title: Delete a single notification
aliases: how do I delete a single notification
body:
1. Select the bell icon at the top of any page.
2. Point to the notification you want to remove.
3. Select the **X** that appears on the right.
Deleting a notification only removes it from your list. It does not change the task or comment it refers to.

title: Choose who receives budget alerts
aliases: change who is warned about budget
send budget warnings to the project manager
how do I choose who receives budget alerts
body:
1. Open the project and select the **Budget** tab.
2. Select **Alerts**.
3. In **Recipients**, add or remove members.
4. Select **Save**.
Recipients receive alerts by email and in the notification bell, based on their own settings.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Unsubscribe a guest from notifications
aliases: how do I unsubscribe a guest from notifications
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Guests**.
2. Select the guest's name.
3. Switch off **Email notifications**.
4. Select **Save**.
The guest can still open the projects they have access to. They can turn notifications back on from the link in any email.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Notify an approver when you submit a timesheet
aliases: how do I notify an approver when you submit a timesheet
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and open the week you want to submit.
2. Select **Submit for approval**.
3. Tick **Send a message to my approver**.
4. Type your message and select **Submit**.
Approvers are always notified of a submission. This option adds your note to the email.

title: Run a utilisation report
aliases: see how busy my team is
body:
1. Go to **Reports** and select **Utilisation**.
2. Choose a date range.
3. Select the members or teams to include.
4. Select **Run report**.
The report shows billable hours as a percentage of each person's weekly target. Use **Group by** to switch between members and teams.

title: Run a time by member report
body:
1. Go to **Reports** and select **Time**.
2. Set **Group by** to **Member**.
3. Choose a date range and projects.
4. Select **Run report**.
Select any row to see the individual time entries behind it.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Run a budget versus actual report
body:
1. Go to **Reports** and select **Budget vs actual**.
2. Choose the projects or clients to include.
3. Select **Run report**.
Each project shows budget, spend to date, remaining amount and a status bar. Projects over budget are marked in red.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Run a project profitability report
aliases: how much profit did we make
body:
1. Go to **Reports** and select **Profitability**.
2. Choose a date range.
3. Select **Run report**.
4. Compare **Revenue**, **Cost** and **Margin** for each project.
Cost uses each member's cost rate, which admins can set under **Members**.
The change is recorded in the activity log for your workspace.

title: Change a report's date range
body:
1. Open the report from **Reports**.
2. Select the **Date range** button.
3. Choose a preset such as **Last month**, or select **Custom** and enter dates.
4. Select **Apply**.
The report refreshes automatically.
You can reverse this at any time by repeating the steps.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Filter a report by client
aliases: narrow a report to a customer
how do I filter a report by client
body:
1. Open the report from **Reports**.
2. Select **Filters**.
3. Choose **Client** and select one or more clients.
4. Select **Apply**.
The filter applies to this view only unless you save the report.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Change how a report is grouped
aliases: group by project instead of member
how do I change how a report is grouped
body:
1. Open the report from **Reports**.
2. Select **Group by**.
3. Choose an option such as **Project**, **Client**, **Member** or **Week**.
The table and chart update straight away. Select **Save report** if you want to keep the new layout.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Export a report to CSV
aliases: download a report as a spreadsheet
body:
1. Open the report from **Reports**.
2. Run it with the date range and filters you want.
3. Select **Export**.
4. Choose **CSV**.
The file downloads to your device with the figures as shown on screen.
The change is recorded in the activity log for your workspace.

title: Export a report as a PDF
aliases: download report to share with client
make a PDF of a report
body:
1. Open the report from **Reports**.
2. Run it with the date range and filters you want.
3. Select **Export**.
4. Choose **PDF**.
5. Select **Include chart** if you want the graph at the top.
The PDF uses your workspace logo and name in the header.

title: Save a report
aliases: how do I save a report
body:
1. Open the report and set the filters and grouping you want.
2. Select **Save report**.
3. Enter a name.
4. Choose **Only me** or **Everyone in workspace**.
5. Select **Save**.
Saved reports appear under **Saved** on the **Reports** page.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Rename a saved report
aliases: how do I rename a saved report
body:
1. Go to **Reports** and select **Saved**.
2. Select the **More** menu beside the report.
3. Select **Rename**.
4. Enter the new name and select **Save**.
Scheduled emails will use the new name from the next send.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Delete a saved report
aliases: get rid of an old report
how do I delete a saved report
body:
1. Go to **Reports** and select **Saved**.
2. Select the **More** menu beside the report.
3. Select **Delete**.
4. Confirm by selecting **Delete report**.
Any schedule attached to the report is deleted too. You can only delete reports that you created, unless you are an admin.

title: Schedule a report to be emailed
aliases: email me a report each month
body:
1. Go to **Reports** and open a saved report.
2. Select **Schedule**.
3. Choose how often to send it: weekly or monthly.
4. Add the email addresses of the people who should receive it.
5. Select **Save schedule**.
Recipients get a PDF and a CSV attached.

title: Stop a scheduled report
aliases: how do I stop a scheduled report
body:
1. Go to **Reports** and select **Scheduled**.
2. Find the report you want to stop.
3. Select the **More** menu, then **Delete schedule**.
4. Confirm in the dialog.
The saved report itself is kept. Only the automatic emails stop.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Add a note to a saved report
aliases: write a comment on a report
how do I add a note to a saved report
body:
1. Go to **Reports** and select **Saved**.
2. Open the report.
3. Select **Add note** below the title.
4. Type your note, for example what the report is used for.
5. Select **Save**.
The note is shown at the top of the report and in PDF exports.

title: Share a report with a client
aliases: send a report link to a customer
give a client access to a report
how do I share a report with a client
body:
1. Open the saved report from **Reports**.
2. Select **Share**.
3. Choose **Share with client** and select the client.
4. Select **Copy link** or **Send email**.
Clients see a read-only view of this report only. Select **Stop sharing** to turn the access off.
The change is recorded in the activity log for your workspace.

title: Invite a member to the workspace
aliases: send an invitation to a colleague
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Members**.
2. Select **Invite member**.
3. Enter their email address and choose a role.
4. Select **Send invite**.
They receive an email with a link to set a password. Invites expire after 14 days.
You can reverse this at any time by repeating the steps.

title: Resend an invitation
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Members**.
2. Select the **Invited** tab.
3. Find the person and select **Resend invite**.
A new link is emailed and the 14-day expiry restarts. Ask them to check their junk folder if it still doesn't arrive.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Change a member's role
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Members**.
2. Select the member's name.
3. Choose a new **Role**: **Admin**, **Project manager** or **Member**.
4. Select **Save**.
The new permissions apply the next time they load a page.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Update a member's phone number
aliases: correct a phone number on a profile
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Members**.
2. Select the member's name.
3. Select **Edit** beside **Phone**.
4. Enter the new number.
5. Select **Save**.
Members can also update their own number from **Profile**.
The change is recorded in the activity log for your workspace.
You can reverse this at any time by repeating the steps.

title: Update a member's email address
aliases: new work email for a member
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Members**.
2. Select the member's name.
3. Select **Edit** beside **Email**.
4. Enter the new address.
5. Select **Save**.
We email the new address to confirm it. The member keeps signing in with the old address until they confirm.
You can reverse this at any time by repeating the steps.

title: Deactivate a member
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Members**.
2. Select the member's name.
3. Select **Deactivate member**.
4. Choose someone to take over their open tasks, or leave them unassigned.
5. Confirm by selecting **Deactivate**.
Their time entries and history are kept. Deactivated members no longer count towards your plan.

title: Reactivate a member
aliases: restore access for a deactivated person
how do I reactivate a member
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Members**.
2. Select the **Deactivated** tab.
3. Select the member's name.
4. Select **Reactivate member** and confirm their role.
They can sign in again straight away. Tasks that were reassigned stay with the new owner.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Add a guest to a project
aliases: let a client view a project
body:
1. Open the project from **Projects**.
2. Select **Share**.
3. Select **Add guest** and enter their email address.
4. Choose **View only** or **Can comment**.
5. Select **Send invite**.
Guests only see this project and do not count as members.
The change is recorded in the activity log for your workspace.

title: Remove a guest
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Guests**.
2. Select the guest's name.
3. Select **Remove guest**.
4. Confirm by selecting **Remove**.
They lose access to all shared projects immediately. Their past comments stay visible.
You can reverse this at any time by repeating the steps.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Add a client
body:
1. Go to **Clients** and select **New client**.
2. Enter the client's name and billing contact email.
3. Add an optional phone number and address.
4. Select **Save**.
You can now link projects and invoices to the client.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Delete a client
aliases: get rid of a client record
how do I delete a client
body:
1. Go to **Clients** and select the client.
2. Select the **More** menu, then **Delete client**.
3. If the client has projects, choose whether to move them to another client or leave them unassigned.
4. Confirm by selecting **Delete**.
Invoices already issued are kept for your records.

title: Add a note to a client
aliases: write a note on a customer record
how do I add a note to a client
body:
1. Go to **Clients** and select the client.
2. Select the **Notes** tab.
3. Select **Add note**.
4. Type your note and select **Save**.
Notes are visible to admins and project managers, never to the client.
The change is recorded in the activity log for your workspace.

title: Change the workspace name
aliases: how do I change the workspace name
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Workspace**.
2. Edit the **Workspace name** field.
3. Select **Save**.
The new name appears in the sidebar, in emails and on invoices. Only admins can change it.
You can reverse this at any time by repeating the steps.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Set the workspace time zone
aliases: how do I set the workspace time zone
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Workspace**.
2. Select **Time zone**.
3. Choose a time zone from the list.
4. Select **Save**.
Due dates, reports and scheduled emails use this time zone. Members can set their own under **Profile**.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Set the working week
aliases: choose which days are work days
how do I set the working week
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Workspace**.
2. Under **Working week**, tick the days your team normally works.
3. Enter the standard hours for each day.
4. Select **Save**.
Timesheets and utilisation reports use these days to work out expected hours.
If you can't see this option, ask a workspace admin to check your role.

title: Create a team
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Teams**.
2. Select **New team**.
3. Enter a team name.
4. Choose the members to add.
5. Select **Create team**.
Teams can be used to filter reports and to assign projects.
The change is recorded in the activity log for your workspace.

title: Export the member list to CSV
aliases: get employee list in a spreadsheet
how do I export the member list to csv
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Members**.
2. Use the filters if you only want some members.
3. Select **Export**.
4. Choose **CSV**.
The file lists each member's name, email, phone, role and status.
You can reverse this at any time by repeating the steps.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.

title: Transfer workspace ownership
aliases: how do I transfer workspace ownership
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Workspace**.
2. Scroll to **Ownership** and select **Transfer ownership**.
3. Choose an existing admin.
4. Enter your password to confirm.
5. Select **Transfer**.
You stay on as an admin. The new owner receives an email confirming the change.
Changes take effect straight away for everyone in the workspace.
